task:
The analytics events table (dashboard/src/components/analytics/EventDetailRow.tsx) wastes horizontal space on desktop and larger screens. When an event row is expanded, the detail content - a two-column key/value definition list plus the tall `response_detail` JSON viewer (Structured/Raw JSON tabs) - is crammed into the left ~third of the row and the entire right side of a wide viewport sits empty. Root cause: the container `<div className="grid grid-cols-[auto_1fr] gap-x-6 gap-y-1.5 max-w-2xl">` in the `EventDetailRow` return caps the whole panel at max-w-2xl (~672px) and renders `response_detail` inline as just another value cell in that narrow grid.

Fix ONLY EventDetailRow.tsx so the expanded detail uses the available horizontal space on large screens, following the repo's utilitarian / information-dense design ethos (density over whitespace, no wasted space, no decorative padding):

1. Remove the `max-w-2xl` cap so the panel can span the full row width.
2. On desktop (a `lg:` breakpoint), lay the content out in a responsive multi-column arrangement that actually fills the width. A good shape: pull `response_detail` OUT of the scalar-field loop and render it in its own wider column BESIDE the scalar key/value fields (e.g. an outer `grid gap-x-8 lg:grid-cols-[minmax(0,1fr)_minmax(0,1.6fr)]` with the scalar fields as one self-start column and the response_detail JSON panel as the wider column). On small screens it must still stack vertically (single column) and remain readable.
3. The scalar fields (id, key_id, status, duration, etc.) still render as a `[auto_1fr]` key/value definition list. Keep the same field set, colors (coloredValue), and the `response_detail` renderer (renderResponseDetailField with its Structured/Raw JSON tabs) - only restructure the LAYOUT. Give response_detail a small key label above/beside its panel so it stays identifiable now that it is separated out.
4. The JSON viewer should be allowed to breathe in its wider column (it currently has max-h-56 internal scroll - that is fine to keep, or widen; do not make it narrower).

Do NOT change any other file. Do NOT alter the field data, the classifier, colors, or the coloredValue/renderResponseDetailField logic beyond what the layout restructure requires. Do NOT weaken, delete, or skip the sensors to force them green.
